install.name: Apple Mail
steps: Open this page in Safari on your Mac and press Copy signature.
In Mail: Mail menu, Settings, Signatures.
Pick your Sidebar account on the left, press +, name it Sidebar.
Untick Always match my default message font, then paste over the placeholder text.
Under Choose Signature, pick Sidebar. Close the window to save.
install.note: The logo lights up in Apple Mail on Mac, iPhone and iPad.

install.name: iPhone and iPad
steps: Open this page in Safari on the phone and tap Copy signature.
Settings, Apps, Mail, Signature.
Choose Per Account, clear the text under your Sidebar address and paste.
If it pastes as plain text, shake the phone and tap Undo Change Attributes. The design comes back.
Go back to save.

install.name: Outlook
steps: Open this page in Edge or Chrome and click Copy signature.
New Outlook or outlook.com: Settings, Account, Signatures, New signature.
Classic Outlook on Windows: File, Options, Mail, Signatures, New.
Paste, name it Sidebar, and set it for new messages and replies.
Save.
install.note: Outlook for Windows shows the finished logo without the motion.

install.name: Gmail
steps: Open this page in Chrome and click Copy signature.
In Gmail on the web: gear icon, See all settings, General.
Under Signature press Create new, name it Sidebar, paste.
Under Signature defaults pick Sidebar for new emails and replies.
Scroll to the bottom and Save Changes.

install.name: Android
steps: Open this page in Chrome on the phone, pick your name and tap Copy plain text.
Gmail app: menu, Settings, your Sidebar address, Mobile signature, paste, OK.
Samsung Email: menu, Settings, your Sidebar account, Signature, turn it on, paste.
install.note: Android mail apps only keep plain text, so the logo does not show there. Desktop and iPhone show the full design.
